import pathlib
base=pathlib.Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/held-out-2/play/users/u036/system/state/workspace')
programs=base/'programs'; programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
path=programs/'task-487b025c.py'
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seeds = [(c, grid[0][c]) for c in range(w) if grid[0][c] != 0]
    for seed_col, color in seeds:
        anchors = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                   if grid[r][c] == color and (r, c) != (0, seed_col)]
        if anchors:
            # Connect the top-row seed to its matching border marker with an L.
            r, c = anchors[0]
            for rr in range(min(r, 0), max(r, 0) + 1):
                out[rr][seed_col] = color
            for cc in range(min(seed_col, c), max(seed_col, c) + 1):
                out[r][cc] = color
        else:
            for r in range(h):
                out[r][seed_col] = color
    return out
'''
path.write_text(code)
